title: Yummy Fluffy Greek Gigantes Plaki
description: A hearty, comforting Greek dish made with tender beans in a rich tomato sauce, served in a clay cazuela. Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Greek gigantes beans (such as Lima beans or butter beans)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay cazuela over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes, vinegar, water, mustard powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked gigantes beans to the sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the cazuela to the oven and bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are heated through and the sauce is bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a satisfying meal.
